scripts.dev: (bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p='package';const t={};for(const c of fs.readdirSync(p))for(const s of fs.readdirSync(p+'/'+c)){const d=p+'/'+c+'/'+s;if(fs.existsSync(d+'/style.css'))t[s]={category:c,css:fs.readFileSync(d+'/style.css','utf8'),spec:fs.readFileSync(d+'/spec.md','utf8')}};fs.writeFileSync('portal/src/themes.json',JSON.stringify(t))" && bun build --watch portal/index.html --outdir dist) & bun --hot serve.ts
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf lib && mkdir lib && for f in package/*/*/style.css; do cp "$f" "lib/$(basename "$(dirname "$f")").css"; done && bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p='package';const t={};for(const c of fs.readdirSync(p))for(const s of fs.readdirSync(p+'/'+c)){const d=p+'/'+c+'/'+s;if(fs.existsSync(d+'/style.css'))t[s]={category:c,css:fs.readFileSync(d+'/style.css','utf8'),spec:fs.readFileSync(d+'/spec.md','utf8')}};fs.writeFileSync('portal/src/themes.json',JSON.stringify(t))"
scripts.build:portal: rm -rf dist && bun build portal/index.html --outdir dist
scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:portal
